### The Untimely Church
Author: Harry Reeder
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/untimely-church
Passage: Acts 13:36
Points:
- Believers must be timely by serving God's purpose in their own generation and addressing contemporary challenges.
- Christians are also untimely because the enduring answer to human need was accomplished in the past at Calvary.
- Faithful followers live ahead of their time by anticipating Christ's future return and eternal kingdom.
- True spiritual effectiveness requires grounding present ministry in historic gospel truth rather than chasing cultural trends.

### If You Feel Overlooked or Underappreciated
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-may-11-2023.html
Passage: Acts 13:22
Points:
- Although David was overlooked by his family and the world, God evaluated his heart and chose him.
- Returning to tend sheep after being anointed served as a vital season to refine David's character.
- Mundane daily chores and routine responsibilities are often God's quiet training ground for our calling.
- Realizing that we are hand-picked by God brings purpose and encouragement to ordinary moments.
